title: Loneliness
definition: Loneliness is the pain of feeling isolated, unseen, forgotten, or without meaningful companionship.
summary: God sees the lonely and draws near to His people. Scripture calls the Church to fellowship, hospitality, compassion, and care for those who feel alone.
christFocus: Christ experienced rejection and abandonment, yet He promises never to forsake His people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God sees the lonely and draws near to His people. Scripture calls the Church to fellowship, hospitality, compassion, and care for those who feel alone.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
